contracts_rationale: Internal runtime refactor plus a run-state behaviour change; no new or changed interface. Event payload schemas, the Decision shape and the orchestrator-api contract are unchanged (spec C-005).
friendly_name: Align the composition-backed run advance with the engine advance
purpose_context: When spec-kitty next advances a software-dev (or any composition-backed) action, it uses a separate planner that skips two records the engine's own advance writes: the audit-significance evaluation of an audit gate and the RACI binding of the step it issues. This mission closes that gap as a specified behaviour change, routes both advances through the engine's single planning and commit authority, keeps the composition path's retrospective gate, single-dispatch and plan-first guarantees, and removes the last complexity suppression in the runtime engine.
purpose_tldr: Make a composition-backed step advance record the same audit-significance and RACI evidence as the engine's own advance, and share one set of event-recording code between the two.
